name: bacpack
description: ManageBac CLI: check what's due, log CAS experiences, and add Learner Portfolio entries from the terminal.

scripts.compile: bun build --compile src/index.ts --outfile ~/.bun/bin/bacpack && mkdir -p $(brew --prefix)/share/man/man1 && cp man/bacpack.1 $(brew --prefix)/share/man/man1/ && mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills/bacpack && cp AGENTS.md ~/.claude/skills/bacpack/SKILL.md
